build_claude_session: build a Claude LLM session using ClaudeSession with API key, base URL, model, and context window configuration
create_tool_client_chat: create a ToolClient that builds protocol prompts with tool instructions and parses mixed LLM responses containing tool calls
run_native_claude_session: run a NativeClaudeSession that calls Claude Code API with beta features, prompt caching, and interleaved thinking support
trim_messages_history: trim LLM message history by compressing thinking and tool-use tags and removing old messages to fit context window
parse_claude_sse_response: parse Claude Anthropic SSE streaming responses into text chunks and structured content blocks with tool use and thinking
